## Date & Time Helpers

Single Responsibility: compute Dubai-local (Asia/Dubai, UTC+4, no DST) date parts and the current budgetMonth (YYYY-MM), mirroring the app's own src/lib/dates.ts (getDubaiCurrentDate / getDubaiMonthRange).

Input (optional): { date: ISOString } — defaults to now.
Output: { isoDate, dubaiYear, dubaiMonth, dubaiDay, budgetMonth, previousBudgetMonth }

Used by: Monthly Rollover Trigger (02) to compute from/to months without hardcoding.
